crossRefs.note: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances.…
Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with…
As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel…
David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.
David said to Michal, “It was before Yahweh, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me…
Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance; the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy…
But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Shiloh
people.line: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period

translations.web: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
translations.bsb: and watch. When you see the daughters of Shiloh come out to perform their dances, each of you is to come out of the vineyards, catch for himself a wife from the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
translations.kjv: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
translations.asv: and see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
